body:
Good morning, my friend!

Today is Sunday, the day of rest. I have a secret too: I've written to everyone in the whole land, inviting them to a Spring Festival here in the valley!

But today there's no work, and no planning. The neighbours are at the chapel. You might visit them, or sit by the river and think of all the friends you've made. Rest well.
summary: Sunday: a day of rest. No work today.
